why_this_run: The census returned a null on judged visual necessity. This run separates the two candidate causes the census cannot distinguish: the document class restating figures in prose (H1) versus the verbatim-quote gate anchoring questions to a text span (H2). The owner instructed investigating the cause while keeping the scope on law textbooks, which is what this measures - it adds no new source and generates no new item.
